jobs.prompt: Bug found while checking why the local (dev2) lane never took a ticket: ticket jobs carry cacheContext (shared context files for prompt caching), and the router's candidate check (pickJobRoute in tools/swarm/core-41.mjs runs validateManifest on the candidate with agent local) fails with 'Job T-0153: cacheContext is for the anthropic lane (agent anthropic or auto)' (tools/swarm/core-31.mjs around line 424-426), so the local lane is silently rejected for every ticket job and the work goes to Anthropic. Fix: cacheContext is accepted on the local lane too (the local adapter simply ignores it: confirm executeApi for agent local does not send cache_control and does not break on the field; if it uses anthropicUserContent for local make sure no cache_control block is produced for local). Keep refusing cacheContext for CLI agents (cursor, codex, claude, hermes etc.). Make withoutApiOnlyFields/the CLI stripping consistent with API_AGENTS including local. Tests in tests/local-lane-cache-context.test.mjs: validateManifest accepts a local job with cacheContext; validateProject on a test-type ticket job with cacheContext and a configured local endpoint routes to local (use the existing fixtures of tests/local-lane.test.mjs); the local request body contains no cache_control; a cursor job with cacheContext is still refused. Keep tests/local-lane*.test.mjs, tests/api-workers.test.mjs, tests/anthropic-lane.test.mjs, tests/ticket-manifest.test.mjs and tests/cache-context-normalize.test.mjs passing.
